title: GPD
constraints:
time limit: 2 seconds
memory limit: 50000 bytes
standard_solution_code:
import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10 ** 6)
(N, Q) = map(int, input().split())
g = dict()
key = dict()
(R, Rkey) = map(int, input().split())
key[R] = Rkey
for i in range(N - 1):
	(u, v, k) = map(int, input().split())
	key[u] = k
	if u not in g:
		g[u] = []
	if v not in g:
		g[v] = []
	g[u].append(v)
	g[v].append(u)

class Trie:

	def __init__(self):
		self.root = [None, None]

	def insert(self, n):
		t = Trie()
		cur = t.root = self.root[:]
		for i in range(30, -1, -1):
			bit = n >> i & 1
			cur[bit] = [None, None] if cur[bit] is None else cur[bit][:]
			cur = cur[bit]
		return t

	def xor_max_min(self, k, minmode):
		cur = self.root
		res = 0
		for i in range(30, -1, -1):
			bit = k >> i & 1
			pref = bit if minmode else not bit
			res = res << 1 | (pref if cur[pref] is not None else not pref)
			cur = cur[pref] if cur[pref] is not None else cur[not pref]
		return res
trie = dict()
trie[R] = Trie().insert(key[R])

def dfs(u, p):
	for v in g[u]:
		if v == p:
			continue
		trie[v] = trie[u].insert(key[v])
		dfs(v, u)
dfs(R, None)
answers = []
last_answer = 0
for q in range(Q):
	(t, *rest) = map(int, input().split())
	t = t ^ last_answer
	if t == 0:
		(v, u, k) = rest
		v ^= last_answer
		u ^= last_answer
		k ^= last_answer
		trie[u] = trie[v].insert(k)
	else:
		(v, k) = rest
		v ^= last_answer
		k ^= last_answer
		t = trie[v]
		min_answer = k ^ t.xor_max_min(k, minmode=True)
		max_answer = k ^ t.xor_max_min(k, minmode=False)
		answers.append(str(min_answer) + ' ' + str(max_answer))
		last_answer = min_answer ^ max_answer
print(*answers, sep='\n')
